events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, turns 54.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of a generation, celebrates turning 54 today. What's your favourite Liam moment, on or off stage?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal anthem 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today, becoming a timeless call for peace and unity.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this iconic song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released (2001)
events.blurb: Apple launched the revolutionary first-generation iPod 25 years ago, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The comedic genius, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: He's not dead yet! Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty, what's your top Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental and eclectic double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', 58 years ago.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your hidden gem from this double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, showmanship, and legacy remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution, was released 61 years ago.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped. An album that truly changed the game. What's the track that still gets you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to echo around the world. What's his most important contribution to you?
